# RNP import filters contain fingerprints with a 0x prefix

The accepted limitedFPRs filter compares full fingerprints as "0x" + k.fpr during unlock and permanent import. The keyRing wrapper still passes a parameter called limitedUids into that position. Recommend names that state the actual identifier kind when modifying this boundary; inspect callers before renaming the legacy parameter. This is a scoped naming recommendation, not a project-wide abbreviation rule. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/extensions/openpgp.
